reply.emotion: matter-of-fact and ordinary, mentioning a standard household fixture
notes: In Spain, el inodoro is the standard, everyday word for a toilet.
Do not confuse it with el váter, which is more colloquial.

senses.definition: Aparato sanitario utilizado para deshacerse de los excrementos.

examples.text: Limpió el inodoro con un producto especial.
examples.translation: He cleaned the toilet with a special product.
examples.emotion: busy and domestic, taking care of household chores
